transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the contract review for the vendor's AI platform. As you all know, we're planning to use this platform to handle customer-support chats and call transcripts beginning next quarter, and the vendor has provided its draft agreement for our review. Before I can give final approval, I need to hear from each of you on your respective areas. Let's go through the scheduled round — privacy, insurance, and customer-contracts counsel, please each share your findings on the vendor's data-use, liability, insurance, and audit provisions. Who would like to start?
